scrape.script_sub
=================

.. py:module:: scrape.script_sub

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   This script scrapes the course titles and descriptions from the CWRU course catelog for a specific subject area.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   scrape.script_sub.collect_courses


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: collect_courses(link, titles, desc)

   Collects course titles and descriptions from a given link using Selenium and BeautifulSoup.
   This function navigates to the provided link, extracts course information, and appends it to the provided lists.

   :param link: URL to the course catalog page for a specific subject area.
   :type link: str
   :param titles: A list to store the extracted course titles
   :type titles: list
   :param desc: A list to store the extracted course descriptions
   :type desc: list
